항목.프롬프트: Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game, one single full-bleed scene with no border and no frame: at night inside the tent sanctuary at Shiloh, a small boy Samuel of about eight years, with long hair and a simple white linen tunic, sits up on a sleeping mat and listens with wide eyes; behind him stands a wide golden menorah lampstand whose seven small oil flames burn in one straight horizontal row at the same height, its six curved branches rising like a fan from the central shaft, seven lamps in all; a soft glow of white-gold light shines gently into the dark tent like a voice calling, with no figure and no face in the light; quiet, holy and hopeful. Every person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet.
